# expense/

## Modules
- `expenseClaimService.ts` — employee expense-claim CRUD + workflow + GL posting (PRD-05 Phase 10).

## Caller contract
Invoked by `withCompany`-wrapped API routes in `pages/api/accounting/expense/*`. Every public function takes `companyId` (usually as an explicit arg or inside an `input` object). UI lives under `pages/accounting/expense/`.

## Main function signatures
- `getCompanyKmRate(companyId): Promise<number>` — resolve per-company SARS km rate.
- `computeMileageAmount(km, rate): number` — pure helper for line totals.
- `createClaim(input): Promise<ExpenseClaim>` — start a `draft` claim.
- `addLine(claimId, companyId, line): Promise<ExpenseClaimLine>` — attach line (amount + VAT + optional mileage + optional `sourceDocumentId`).
- `deleteLine(lineId, companyId): Promise<boolean>`
- `getClaim(id, companyId): Promise<ExpenseClaim | null>`
- `listClaims(companyId, filters): Promise<ExpenseClaim[]>`
- `submitClaim / approveClaim / rejectClaim / cancelClaim` — state-machine transitions.
- `postClaimToGl(claimId, companyId, userId): Promise<{ journalEntryId: string }>` — posts the single JE for the approved claim.

## Business rules
- State machine: `draft → submitted → approved → posted → paid`; side branches `rejected`, `cancelled`. Transitions guarded inside the service.
- `postClaimToGl` posts ONE journal entry: DR expense lines (ex-VAT), DR VAT Input (sum), CR employee reimbursement liability; `status` flips to `posted` and `created_by` + `status='posted'` are stamped on the JE.
- JE `source` uses the dedicated `auto_expense_claim` value (migration 422 added it to the JE `source` CHECK constraint).
- Evidence: JE header carries no `source_document_id` (claim is many-to-one), but each journal line records `source_document_line_id` when the claim line has one.
- Posting agent stamped as `human:<userId>` or `ai:expense-claim`.
- Dates: inputs normalised to `YYYY-MM-DD` strings — both `Date` and `string` shapes handled.

## Related files
- `pages/api/accounting/expense/*.ts` — routes that call these services.
- `pages/accounting/expense/*.tsx` — claimant + approver UI.
- `scripts/migrations/sql/420_*`, `421_*`, `422_auto_expense_claim_je_source.sql` — expense schema + JE source CHECK.
